title: Evaluate the mirror null-guard gate for the sparse action `visible`/`disabled` binding — #4953's clause-2 remainder, whose premise moved when objectui#4079 landed
body:
Filed **unassigned and ungraded** by the `domain:metadata`/`engine-core` seat (PM session `session_01XeQRiAa7vYRVX5Fog7Zby8`) while closing out #4953 on the maintainer's direct instruction. For triage to grade.

⛔ This is **not** a new proposal. It is the last un-carded deliverable of the maintainer's **2026-08-06 ruling on #4953**, which asked for three items; the other two are settled (see "Provenance"). It has sat un-carded since 2026-08-08, when the contract-first sub-issue split the ruling asked triage for did not happen.

## What is already DECIDED — ⛔ do not re-open

The action `visible` / `disabled` face **stays sparse, permanently**. That is recorded in the ledger at `packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts`, measured on `origin/main` @ `b3f9831cb`:

```
| action `visible` / `disabled` | sparse | evaluated client-side; no materialization
  exists in `objectui` | excluded (decided — #4953 clause 2) |
```

> #4953 clause 2 defers making this binding total — it would mean every REST read padding out all declared columns — so the face stays sparse, is documented as sparse, and an author there guards with `has()`. **The exclusion is permanent under the current decision, not pending one.**

So this card is ⛔ **not** "make the action binding total", and ⛔ not a widening of `checkNullGuards`. Both are refused by the decision above.

## What is actually owed

The ledger names the replacement action in the same breath, and that is this card:

> The ruling's replacement action for this face is the **MIRROR** of this gate — **flag `!= null` on a sparse binding** — and it is an evaluation **owed by the devx / objectui lanes**.

Note the word the ruling uses: **evaluation**. The deliverable is a measured recommendation on whether that mirror gate is worth building (and where it would run), not an unconditional instruction to ship one. A well-evidenced "not worth it" closes this card legitimately.

The inversion that makes it a mirror rather than an extension, from the same ledger:

| predicate | TOTAL binding (`{a: null}`) | SPARSE binding (`{}`) |
|---|---|---|
| `has(record.a)` | `true` | `false` |
| `record.a != null` | `false` | **FAULT — `No such key: a`** |

On a total binding `!= null` is the cure and `checkNullGuards` flags its absence. On a sparse binding `!= null` is **itself the fault** and `has()` is the correct guard — so the existing gate cannot catch this face, and a rule pointed the other way is required.

## ⚠️ The premise moved on 2026-08-10, and nothing recorded it

This is the part worth a fresh measurement rather than inheriting the 2026-08-06 framing.

**objectui#4075 closed 2026-08-10 via merged PR objectui#4079** — *"bind the row three ways on the four action renderers"*. Before it:

- `action-menu.tsx` / `action-group.tsx` passed **no record context at all**;
- `action-button.tsx` / `action-icon.tsx` bound the row at the **bare root only**, so `record.status == 'pending'` threw `record is not defined` and failed closed.

⇒ On those renderers a `record.*` predicate faulted at the **namespace** level, which made the *sparseness* question moot there — you could not reach it. After #4079 the row binds three ways (`record.x`, bare `x`, `data.x`), so authored `record.x != null` predicates now resolve the namespace and **reach the sparse-binding fault for real**.

**The mirror gate's value went up when #4079 landed, and the ledger was written before that.** Whoever takes this card should price it against today's renderers, not the 2026-08-06 ones. ⛔ Do not carry the ledger's cost estimate forward without re-reading `useCondition` / `evalRowPredicate` on current `main` of both repos — a cross-reference is a claim about the world, and this one is known to have decayed once already.

Also relevant and unchanged: a fault here is **fail-closed** — the action silently vanishes, which is indistinguishable from "the gate said no". The trap is real; only the prescription inverts.

## Landing site — measured, and it is not where the ruling's wording suggests

The ruling's item 2 is phrased as "the objectui action surface", which reads like an `objectui` card. Measured, the *work* lands in this repo:

- The gate and its ledger are `packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts` — **objectstack**.
- `declared-fields.ts` states the same contract from the engine side — **objectstack**.
- `objectui` is where the *surface* is, but it contains no materialization step and, under the permanent-sparse decision, is not being changed.

By the anchoring rule (`domain:*` = the domain of the package the fix lands in), my read is **`domain:devx`**. ⛔ Recorded as a read, not applied — this seat is not the producer of `domain:*` labels, and if the evaluation concludes the rule belongs in an objectui-side lint pass instead, the routing changes with it.

## Provenance — the other two ruling items, so nobody re-derives them

| Ruling item | Status |
|---|---|
| **1** — materialize the two server-side seams | ✅ **Complete.** `readonlyWhen` via PR #6454 (2026-08-07); flow-trigger record seeding via PR #8483 (2026-08-13). |
| **2** — this card | ⬜ Open, un-carded until now. |
| **3** — #4811's null-guard gate widening | ⛔ **Void.** #4811 closed `completed` 2026-08-03, **ten days before** either seam landed; the prior seat's own correction `5285969957` records this. There is no open #4811 to unblock. A gate widening, if still wanted, is a new card that must first read PR #4951 — its title says it *decided* the remaining surfaces (「其余各面按绑定全量性定案」) rather than deferring them, and the binding totality it decided against has since changed underneath that decision. |

Anchor card #4953 is closed alongside this filing; its remaining work is this card and nothing else.

## Not claimed

- ⛔ No measurement of the mirror rule's false-positive rate. That is the evaluation this card asks for.
- ⛔ No claim that the rule should ship. "Evaluate" is the ruling's own word.
- ⛔ The renderer re-measurement above is read from objectui#4075's body and PR #4079's merge state, **not** re-verified against current `objectui` `main` by this seat. Treat it as dated evidence.
